buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses A. QUALIFYING REQUIREMENTS for Bidders Technical Capability a) Bidder must be manufacturer /Authorized Dealer of the CNG Tipper/Truck of engine power 90 Kw or high er capacity. b) Bidder should have supplied at least one No of CNG Tipper/Truck of engine power 90 Kw or above per a nnum on an average during the last Seven years before the bid opening date to any Central/ State Govt. O rganization/ PSU/ Public listed Company. For fulfilling the experience criteria any one of the following documents may be considered as valid proof f or meeting the experience criteria: 1. Purchase Order copy along with Invoice(s) with self-certification by the bidder that supplies against the i nvoices have been executed. 2. Execution and the performance certificate by client with order value. 3. Any other document in support of order execution like third party inspection release note, etc. Financial Capability.

1. The average annual turnover of the bidder during the last three financial years ending 31st March 2026 should be at least Rs. 6.97 Lakhs (30% of annual estimated cost of case ie. Rs. 23.23 Lakhs plus GST). The Documentary evidence indicating the turnover details for the relevant period shall be in the form of certifie d Audited Balance Sheets and profit & loss account statement of preceding three years or turnover certific ates from the Chartered Accountant / Cost Accountant along with UDIN to be uploaded with the bid. In cas e the date of constitution / incorporation of the bidder are less than 3 year old, the average turnover in res pect of the completed financial years after the date of constitution shall be taken into account for these cri teria. (GeM portal accepts Turnover in lakhs in whole numbers only) 2. Three executed PO costing not less than the amount Rs. 9.29 lakhs each OR Two executed PO costing not less than the amount Rs. 11.61 lakhs each OR One executed PO costing not less than the amount Rs. 18.59 lakhs each Special Note:- In this bid while inserting the value of Turnover in provided tab it has been taken as 07 lakh s instead of 6.97 lakhs since it takes digits in round figures only. However bidders having turnover of 6.97 lakhs per annum or above shall be acceptable. Scope of work 1. Supply Tipper as per technical specification defined. 2. The Registration, Fitness certificate from transport department and comprehensive insurance cover fro m the Insurance company (PSU) is in the scope of the vendor/authorised dealer 3. To provide speed governor device along with the certificate is in the scope of the vendor. Special T&C: 1. Tipper with Scoop body. 2. The bidder shall ensure that the tipper is equipped with a functional and temper proof electronic speed g overnor/ speed limiting device conforming to applicable CMVR/Motor Vehicle Act provisions and any directi ons issued by transport authorities of Govt. of NCT of Delhi. 3. The registration of vehicle with transport authority of Delhi is in the scope of vendor. 4. The vehicle should be insured as *Comprehensive insurance* from a government insurance company w hich is in the scope of the vendor. 5. For the expenditure incurred on account of registration of vehicle, fitness of the vehicle, insurance of the vehicle and the speed governor device & fitting and the relevant certificate over and above the basic cost of the vehicle will be considered for payment as per the actuals on furnishing the relevant documents whil e submitting the invoice along with the invoice payment of Tipper vehicle. 6. EVALUATION CRITERIA: OVERALL, BASIS L1 7. DELIVERY PERIOD: 05 Months from the date of receipt of PO. However, bidder will try to execute the ord er as soon as possible 8. Guarantee/ Warranty: Minimum 1 year from the date of supply or 1 Lakh Km whichever is earlier. 9. PDI: Applicable 10. EMD: Applicable. The bidder seeking EMD exemption, must submit the valid supporting document for t he relevant category with the bid. Under MSE category (Micro & Small Enterprises), only manufacturers of goods are eligible for exemption from EMD. Traders are excluded from the purview of this P olicy Note: Bid of different vendors received from same IP address will not be considered and bid s hall be out rightly rejected for this tender. No further communication will be made in this rega rd .
